newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: World Bank grants Zambia $45 mln BoP support.
newsitem.headline: World Bank grants Zambia $45 mln BoP support.

text.p: The Zambian Finance Minister announced on Friday that the World Bank had granted the country the first tranche of a $90 million dollar balance of payments support package.
"The World Bank released $45 million to us yesterday and will release the rest next year," minister Ronald Penza told Reuters in an interview.
The loan is part of a $90 million package under the second Economic and Social Adjustment Credit facility.
The initial tranche was originally supposed to have been released in August, but was withheld until the country met certain economic criteria set by the bank.
"The IMF and World Bank were here in August and waited for our September benchmarks and gave us a clean bill of health," Penza said.
One of the main benchmarks set by the bank was that the country maintain a healthy state of reserves.
Penza said the rest of the package would be released some time next year.
"This is a show of confidence in the Zambian economic programme," Penza said.
